name: PROTAC translational safety and preclinical assay cascade plotting
purpose: L2 procedural case: agent chains bioresearcher-python-setup-uv and bioresearcher-plot-making to generate a publication-grade Three-Panel Composite figure from literature data fixtures, passing 3-layer QA gates.
prompt: Using the input data in {DATA_DIR}, first use bioresearcher-python-setup-uv to install the scientific visualization dependencies (matplotlib, pymupdf, numpy, pillow). Then use bioresearcher-plot-making to create a Three-Panel Composite figure in figures/protac_risk_cascade/ following the literature-search_method-summary specification. Include status dot glyph legends in Panel b (adverse signal, no signal, under-reported) and assay PMID provenance in Panel c. Generate fig1_method_summary (.pdf, .svg, .png), run the bundled QA gates (audit_panel_alignment.py, audit_figure_collisions.py, and audit_pdf_text.py), and provide LEGENDS.md. Ensure all QA gates pass.
